column1: # wall2seconds fixture data — Octave/MATLAB reference for parity testing
# Source: realized/wall2seconds.m — Wall clock-to-seconds past midnight conversion
# Converts wall-clock times in HHMMSS numeric format (e.g. 93047 = 09:30:47)
#   - wall is cast to double to protect against integer inputs
#   seconds:  m-by-1 column vector of times measured as seconds past midnight
#   1. market_open:        wall=93000  -> seconds=34200 (US equity market open)
#   2. market_close:       wall=160000 -> seconds=57600 (US equity market close)
#   3. market_range:       14 wall times every 30 min from 9:30-16:00
#   5. sub_second:         wall times with fractional seconds (93000.5
#   7. late_evening:       wall=235959 -> seconds=86399 (near end of valid range)
